per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null (mandatory primary/join key)
S_N must be unique across all records
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N (referential integrity)
Account_No must not be null (mandatory business identifier)
Account_No must be a 4-digit code
Name must not be null
Name must not be in all lowercase or all uppercase (should be Title Case)
Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o for Male, Binte/d/o for Female)
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter (e.g., S1234567D)
ID_No must be unique (no duplicates)
Race must not be null
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian (case-sensitive after standardization)
Gender must not be null
Gender must be either Male or Female (case-sensitive after standardization)
Age must not be null
Age must be numeric (parseable as integer)
Age must be between 0 and 120 (inclusive)
Age must be at least 13 (realistic for service account)
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must contain exactly 8 digits (Singapore phone number format)
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol and no spaces
Country must not be null
Country must be standardized to 'Singapore' (no abbreviations, alternative languages, or casing variations)
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must not be in all uppercase (should be Title Case)
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N (allowing for case differences)
ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty exactly for the same S_N
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
